source.snippet: I have an Agentforce agent built in one org (Agentforce Builder with Agent Script). Installing the org-dependent unlocked package (or plain sf project deploy start of the same source) into another org fails before any component is processed: 'Your org doesn't have access to this type of CMS workspace' error. Both agent deployment and installation fails with this error.

problem_statement: Salesforce developers and admins cannot reliably deploy Agentforce agents across orgs — cryptic CMS workspace permission errors block both package install and direct metadata deploy, with no clear remediation path from Salesforce documentation.
target_segment: Salesforce developers, Salesforce admins, and ISV partners building Agentforce-based products on the Salesforce platform
notes: Salesforce ecosystem has a well-established paid tooling market (Gearset, Copado, AutoRABIT charge $300–$1500+/user/year for deployment tooling). Agentforce is brand-new and deployment tooling has not caught up. A focused Agentforce cross-org deployment validator/fixer could command SaaS pricing. Buyer is clear: Salesforce developer or admin at a company or ISV paying for platform licences. Single post but the underlying Agentforce deployment friction is a known ecosystem pain point circa 2026.
